title: CPF Module Schema: Azure App Configuration Key and Featureflag module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-appconfigurationkeyfeatureflag'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Azure App Configuration Key and Featureflag module

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

appconfiguration_id.description: (Required) The ID of the App Configuration store where the keys will be created.

config_keys.type: map(object({ key = string label = optional(string, null) value = optional(string, null) content_type = optional(string, null) locked = optional(bool, false) type = optional(string, "kv") vault_key_reference = optional(string, null) }))
config_keys.description: (Optional) A map of App Configuration keys to create. Each key in the map represents a configuration entry with the following structure: map(object({ key = "(Required) The name of the App Configuration Key to create. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." label = "(Optional) The label of the App Configuration Key. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." value = "(Optional) The value of the App Configuration Key." content_type = "(Optional) The content type of the App Configuration Key." locked = "(Optional) Should this App Configuration Key be Locked to prevent changes. Defaults to false." type = "(Optional) The type of the App Configuration Key. It can either be kv (simple key/value) or vault (where the value is a reference to a Key Vault Secret). Defaults to kv." vault_key_reference = "(Optional) The ID of the vault secret this App Configuration Key refers to. This should only be set when type is set to vault." }))

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

feature_flags.type: map(object({ name = string key = optional(string, null) label = optional(string, null) enabled = optional(bool, false) description = optional(string, null) locked = optional(bool, false) percentage_filter_value = optional(number, null) targeting_filter = optional(object({ default_rollout_percentage = number groups = optional(list(object({ name = string rollout_percentage = number }))) users = optional(list(string)) })) timewindow_filter = optional(object({ start = string end = string })) }))
feature_flags.description: (Optional) A map of App Configuration feature flags to create. map(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the App Configuration Feature. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." key = "(Optional) The key of the App Configuration Feature. The value for name will be used if this is unspecified. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." label = "(Optional) The label of the App Configuration Feature Flag. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." enabled = "(Optional) The state of the Feature Flag. Defaults to false." description = "(Optional) The description of the Feature Flag." locked = "(Optional) Should this App Configuration Feature Flag be Locked to prevent changes? Defaults to false." percentage_filter_value = "(Optional) A number representing a percentage of the user base for which this feature should be enabled. Valid values are between 0 and 100." targeting_filter = optional(object({ default_rollout_percentage = "(Required) A number representing a percentage of the user base for which this feature should be enabled by default." groups = optional(list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the group." rollout_percentage = "(Required) Percentage of the group for which the feature should be enabled." }))) users = "(Optional) A list of users to target for this feature flag." })) timewindow_filter = optional(object({ start = "(Required) The start time of the time window. Should be in RFC3339 format." end = "(Required) The end time of the time window. Should be in RFC3339 format." })) }))

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

app_configuration_feature_flag_ids.description: The IDs of the managed app configuration feature flags.

app_configuration_feature_flag_names.description: The names of the managed app configuration feature flags.

app_configuration_key_ids.description: The IDs of the managed app configuration keys.

app_configuration_key_names.description: The names of the managed app configuration keys.

resource_feature_flag.description: The azure app configuration feature flag resources (map of all feature flags).

resource_key.description: The azure app configuration key resources (map of all keys).

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Appconfigurationkeyfeatureflag' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
